description: The polite stop request sent by orchestrators and `docker stop`. Catchable: the process should drain and exit.
Sent after the grace period. Cannot be caught: whatever was in progress is lost.
Time between SIGTERM and SIGKILL (30 s in Kubernetes by default). The shutdown timeout must be shorter.
Stop accepting new connections but let in-flight requests finish. `server.close(callback)` does this.
Health endpoint the load balancer uses to route traffic. Failing it during shutdown stops new requests from arriving.
A second signal returns the shutdown already in progress instead of closing and cleaning up twice.
